2609.15624.title: Beyond AI Literacy: A Structured Review and Exploratory Meta-Analysis of Measures for Competent Generative-AI Use
2609.15624.paper_summary: Researchers assessing competent generative-AI use at work must choose among self-reports, objective tests, and measures of oversight and reliance. We conducted a structured, seeded review of 24 focal empirical publications, starting from the 2024 COSMIN-based review and adding a targeted update through 17 August 2026. We grouped the measures into four domains: knowledge and use, epistemic oversight, reliance calibration, and operational control of tool-using agents. In an exploratory meta-analysis, we pooled three direct subjective-objective correlations from one research program (REML r = .055; Hartung-Knapp 95% CI [-.047, .156]; combined reported N = 2,765). We could not resolve a discrepancy between the largest study's reported correlation and p-value, leaving its weight uncertain. Adding a synthetic mean of 12 cross-factor correlations from a fourth study gave r = .079 (95% CI [-.025, .181]). This sensitivity analysis concerns a broader comparison. From this small evidence base, we cannot establish a population correlation, validate workplace cutoffs, or justify substituting self-ratings for performance scores. We identified tests of foundation knowledge (AICOS-S and GLAT) and measures of verification, reliance, trust, and dependency. We found no validated individual-level instrument in the focal corpus that tests the full combination of agent scope, permissions, recovery, state isolation, independent review, and evidence-based closure; some cover subsets. We propose a four-layer workplace battery with non-compensatory decision rules, but have not tested its thresholds or whether it improves on other assessment approaches.
2609.15624.paper_summary_zh: 研究人員在評估工作中生成式人工智慧的有效使用時，必須在自我報告、客觀測試以及監督和依賴的衡量標準之間做出選擇。<lb/>我們對24篇重點實證出版物進行了結構化的種子回顧，從2024年基於COSMIN的回顧開始，並在2026年8月17日進行了針對性的更新。<lb/>我們將這些衡量標準分為四個領域：知識與使用、認識監督、依賴校準以及工具使用代理的操作控制。<lb/>在一項探索性元分析中，我們從一個研究計劃中匯總了三個直接的主觀-客觀相關性（REML r = .055；Hartung-Knapp 95% CI [-.047, .156]；合併報告的N = 2,765）。<lb/>我們無法解決最大研究報告的相關性和p值之間的差異，這使得其權重不確定。<lb/>從第四項研究中添加12個跨因素相關性的合成均值，得出r = .079（95% CI [-.025, .181]）。<lb/>這一敏感性分析涉及更廣泛的比較。<lb/>基於這小量的證據，我們無法建立一個人口相關性，驗證工作場所的臨界值，或證明用自我評分替代績效分數的合理性。<lb/>我們確定了基礎知識的測試（AICOS-S和GLAT）以及驗證、依賴、信任和依賴性的衡量標準。<lb/>我們在重點文獻中未找到驗證的個體層級工具，該工具測試代理範圍、許可、恢復、狀態隔離、獨立審查和基於證據的結束的完整組合；有些涵蓋了子集。<lb/>我們提出了一個四層的工作場所電池，具有非補償性決策規則，但尚未測試其閾值或是否優於其他評估方法。
